meta.name: bevy-ecs-expert
meta.description: Write idiomatic, high-performance Bevy 0.19 ECS code in Rust: components, required components, BSN scenes, queries, systems, resources-as-components, observers and messages, relationships, scheduling, and parallelism. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Bevy, `bevy_ecs`, ECS architecture in Rust, or is writing game logic with entities/components/systems — and especially when porting code from Bevy 0.14–0.18, since nearly every ECS API was renamed across those releases.
